Croatia equalise again as England drawing 2-2 in thrilling World Cup opener

Match Summary

FIFA World Cup -
Group Stage -
Group L
England 2 , Croatia 2
EnglandEnglandEngland
2
2
CroatiaCroatiaCroatia

Key Events

  • H. Kane (12' pen, 42')Penalty 12 minutes, Goal 42 minutes

England v Croatia

BBC Radio 5 Live

England v Croatia

BBC Radio 5 Live

  • Live Reporting (active)
  • Report
  • Scores
  • Tables
  • Line-ups
  • Match Stats
  • Head-to-head

Summary

  • Croatia twice come back to level with England in Three Lions' opening World Cup game

  • Musa and Baturina equalise twice after Kane's double for England

  • Kane scored thumping header and early retaken penalty after initial spot-kick was saved

  • Ghana & Panama also in Group L

  • Watch post-match reaction show with Rooney, Hart and Richards on this page after full-time

Send us your views

    Switched off twice, conceded twice. Same old England.

  2. 'England picked open far too easily'published at 21:53 BST
    21:53 BST

    HT: England 2-2 Croatia

    Paul Robinson
    Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Dallas Stadium

    It's a side foot finish from Petar Musa into the England net. It's a really well worked goal.

    That's going to change the mood in the England dressing room and tone of Thomas Tuchel's team talk.

    They were picked open far too easily with a simple ball over the top.

    Share page
    About sharing

  3. HALF-TIMEpublished at 21:52 BST
    21:52 BST

    England 2-2 Croatia

    So many positives for England to take there. They have looked up for it and a real threat at times.

    But they've been punished for a mistake and some sloppy defending.

    Share page
    About sharing

  4. 'Perfect for Musa to run onto'published at 21:51 BST

    England 2-2 Croatia

    Lee Dixon
    Former England defender on ITV

    Is Perisic offside? It might have been Konsa's leg that kept him on. The lay back is perfect for Musa to run onto. He gets his knee over the ball, Pickford no chance.

    About sharing

  5. GOAL - England 2-2 Croatiapublished at 21:50 BST
    21:50 BST

    Petar Musa (45+5 mins)

    Well, England can't see out the opening 45 minutes.

    The pass from the centre is super and Ivan Perisic knocks it to the left for Petar Musa to run onto and slot home.

    England twice in front and Croatia twice drawing level.
